albums.title: Chester, at camera speed.

albums.section_title: A slow walk, with excellent distractions.

albums.title: Looking up. Way up.
albums.description: Liverpool Cathedral: very high ceilings, very small humans, and a camera doing its best to fit it all in.
albums.section_title: A little perspective. Quite a lot of ceiling.
albums.signoff: Liverpool Cathedral, 9 August 2026. Plenty of reasons to look up.

albums.title: First stop: Manchester.
albums.description: A first visit, a few detours, and a camera with no sense of urgency.

albums.title: First frames. Many distractions.
